goal.request: Apply the referenced and subsequently expanded Korean summer-trend research to visual-semantics and candidate-pack data, then use three independent subagents to author, generate, and pixel-test different random complex appearance-reference concepts.

evidence.claim: The referenced conversation and its later domestic-trend addition prioritize capri lengths, harem or balloon volume, lace and wrap construction, lightweight layers, low-profile or jelly footwear, small accessories, and lemon accents, but mix popularity labels with observable garment structure.

Current official KakaoStyle, Musinsa, and 29CM material supports the domestic summer candidate priorities, while a Museums Victoria record supports gathered-ankle harem structure; none of these sources establishes pixel fidelity or hidden textile performance.

Runtime data now contains twenty-six relevant axis-owned candidate IDs, including twenty-three new and three strengthened candidates, plus six narrow five-component visual profiles for capri, harem, balloon, wrap, attached lace trim, and molded translucent jelly footwear.

At the summer-isolated checkpoint, dictionary validation passed with 252 registry-bound profiles, 1353 exact terms, and 7835 sharded semantic entries; the focused summer suite passed 10 tests. After an unrelated concurrent task extended the same shared assets, the current combined worktree also validates with 259 profiles, 1404 exact terms, 7842 semantic entries, and the summer suite still passes all 10 tests.

evidence.claim: The independent capri arm delivered one 1023 by 1537 image whose two legs, paired below-knee hems, paired bare ankle gaps, unobstructed landmarks, and non-Bermuda or non-ankle-crop boundary all pass at the required scales.

The independent harem arm delivered one 1024 by 1536 image whose gathered waist, roomy seat-crotch, bilateral hip-thigh volume, paired gathered cuffs, and substitute boundary all pass at the required scales; translucent molded sandals are also visible but are not part of the scored harem gates.

The independent lace arm passed its v6 pack, composed prompt, and runtime audits, but its one authorized image call was blocked at output moderation and returned no pixels; all five lace gates are therefore unscored and no retry was made.

Three explicitly isolated subagents used separate frozen request envelopes, authorial cores, visual intents, candidate packs, prompts, and run directories with no cross-arm inputs. Each arm made exactly one image call; two delivered images and one was blocked.

Coordinator direct reinspection corroborates 10 of 10 gates across the two delivered images and records the blocked lace arm separately; this was not blind to assignment or subagent verdict and does not score user preference.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A selected summer garment meaning must survive as its own visible same-frame topology rather than as a retailer label or styling mood, while the supplied portrait affects only visible adult appearance cues and user preference remains separately unscored.

invariants.statement: Every promoted garment profile requires five independently reviewable components and five fail-closed gates that distinguish the nearest retail or visual substitute.
causal_controls: exact narrow phrase activates one hard profile
broad or negated neighboring terms stay non-hard
one missing or ambiguous delivered-image gate fails that arm

invariants.statement: Outfit formulas are decomposed across wardrobe, garment detail, silhouette, footwear, surface, accessory, and color owners so one trend label cannot silently force every styling dimension.
causal_controls: candidate IDs have exactly one slot owner
semantic metadata supports human use without protected-trait inference
performance and hidden-construction claims stay outside visual candidates

invariants.statement: Package, prompt, runtime request, delivered pixels, and requesting-user preference remain distinct evidence layers, and an output block is recorded as blocked rather than as visual failure or success.
causal_controls: prompt and runtime audits precede generation
pixel gates cite delivered images only

invariants.statement: Each test arm uses only its own frozen lineage, one appearance reference, one image call, and no sibling-arm artifact, while coordinator review occurs only after the arms complete.
causal_controls: one image call and no retry per arm

flexible_dimensions: camera, light, and composition that preserve assigned gates
fictional styling details unrelated to identity
explicit requester definitions that override a default

mismatches.source_state: Domestic retail and editorial research ranks current terms and combinations but does not define a sufficient pixel contract.
mismatches.render_state: Only six narrow structures are hard profiles; popularity percentages, broad styling labels, hidden cups, fiber claims, comfort, cooling, UV, and waterproofing remain outside pixel certainty.

mismatches.source_state: Capri, Bermuda, 7/8 crop, harem, balloon, straight wide, and jogger names overlap across retail taxonomies and can be substituted by a generator.
mismatches.render_state: Length landmarks, upper-volume relations, leg curvature, hem topology, and explicit substitute rejects own the hard decision rather than the label alone.

mismatches.source_state: The lace arm contains five audited prompt bindings for base material, narrow band, openwork cells, attachment line, and scalloped free edge.
mismatches.render_state: The output moderation block returned no image, so none of those five visual relations can be scored from pixels.

hypotheses.statement: Five profile-owned component relations and nearest-substitute rejects will reduce common retail-label substitutions in complex generated scenes.
hypotheses.falsifier: A broad or neighboring term creates the hard profile, or a delivered image passes while a required topology component is absent or ambiguous.

hypotheses.statement: Separating wardrobe formula, construction detail, silhouette, material, footwear, accessory, and color will let candidate packs combine domestic summer cues without one monolithic trend entry overriding the frozen scene.
hypotheses.falsifier: A candidate appears in multiple owner slots, lacks semantic metadata, or is required over a conflicting authorial core.

hypotheses.statement: A knee-up or closer frame with explicit base-material, openwork, stitch-line, and scallop evidence should make attached lace trim auditable when image delivery succeeds.
hypotheses.falsifier: A delivered rerender at the recorded detail scale collapses the trim into print, whole-lace fabric, embroidery, ruffle, or detached accessory.

intervention.general_rule: Translate current summer-trend priorities into axis-owned candidate atoms and narrow five-component topology profiles; promote only exact observable structure and keep broad popularity, hidden construction, performance, identity, and user taste outside pixel claims.
intervention.generalization_basis: The same length-landmark, volume-and-cuff, panel-overlap, material-boundary, and molded-transmission method applies across the prioritized dailywear categories while retaining profile-specific substitute controls.

covered_axes: stitch line and scalloped free edge

decision.rationale: The domestic research translation, twenty-six axis-owned candidate entries, six five-component profiles, regenerated indexes, focused and v6 retrieval tests, and all three pack-prompt-runtime audits pass. The two delivered independent images also pass all ten assigned hard gates under subagent and coordinator inspection. Render promotion is not justified because the third required lace arm was blocked before pixels, leaving five gates unscored; user aesthetic approval is also pending. The implementation remains useful and structurally validated, but the next authorized iteration should requalify only the blocked lace delivery with the same frozen visual duties and a newly audited, moderation-safe commercial detail concept rather than silently rewriting this run.
